source_text.body:
Audit vendor dashboard paths and correct stale docs
Claude in Chrome walked 106 dashboard paths read-only across the poster's Stripe, Cloudflare, Supabase and GitHub accounts, and eight changed paths were corrected in the records.
·
Oct 31, 2026
Done with
CH
Claude in Chrome
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The poster used Claude in Chrome to traverse 106 vendor dashboard paths in their own Stripe, Cloudflare, Supabase, and GitHub accounts with read-only access. The agent compared what it found against existing records and vendor docs, then the poster folded those observations back into a shared knowledge store of dated, sourced console paths and notes.
How it went
It found that 8 of the 106 paths had moved since the vendor docs were written, and those records were corrected. The source does not give more detail on failures for this specific audit beyond saying the browsing was read-only.
Worth knowing
The main catch is scope and access: this was done read-only inside the poster’s own accounts, and the source only reports path corrections, not a reusable automation recipe.
Try it yourself
with
Claude in Chrome
Copy prompt
Go through this list of dashboard paths for my [Stripe, Cloudflare, Supabase, GitHub] accounts, which is in [paste the list or doc]. Open each one in read-only mode, never click save, delete or change any setting, and tell me whether the path still works and matches what my docs say. A finished job is a table of each path with its status, and a list of corrected paths for the docs. Show me the corrections before you edit anything.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1xlllyx/i_built_a_shared_knowledge_store_for_agents_with
